name: redesign
summary: Modernise an existing UI by auditing it first, then delivering every screen in scope — not a sample.

when: an existing product or page needs to be brought up to standard

steps: Audit before touching anything: what is actually wrong, and which of it is a token problem rather than a screen problem.
Fix at the token layer wherever the fault is systemic. A redesign that repaints screens one at a time rebuilds the drift.
Deliver every screen in scope. Split only at a clean boundary when length forces it, and continue to completion.
Render and look at each one.
output: The audit, then the complete redesigned set.
done: the count delivered equals the count in scope
each screen was screenshotted and inspected, not just generated
